summary: Texas Forest Service all-steel tower near Chita, Trinity County; table records 1934 build, 1970 move to Chita (Loc 2); no source describes either site today.

facts.design: All-steel tower with an enclosed cabin at the top (NGS station description); table lists manufacturer EMSCO
facts.status_note: Listed as Gone on firelookout.org; the table records removal in 1970, when the tower moved to Chita (Loc 2)

events.note: NGS station described in 1942 as a Texas Forest Service lookout tower about 125 feet high
Table lists Chita (Loc 1) removed in 1970 and moved to Chita (Loc 2)
Table lists Chita (Loc 2), the site it moved to, as removed and sold in 1981

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NGS station description says about 125 feet (38.1 m); the Texas table lists 100 feet. The record keeps the survey figure, which matches the existing brief.

sources.title: Chita (Loc 1), National Geodetic Survey station description
TX expanded, Texas lookout tower table

notes_for_editor: Build year: the table gives 1934, and the NGS description dated 1942 shows a Texas Forest Service tower already on the station, which fits the table's date. Height: NGS 125 ft (brief's 38.1 m kept) vs table 100 ft. Chita (Loc 2) is a separate list entry (31.01442, -95.23913), used only as the move destination; its 1970-1981 dates and sale come from the table alone. No staffing, fire or access sources. The Lufkin Daily News article and the Texas Forest Service history page were rate-limited or blocked and were not read. No current-site source. Two WebSearch calls were used. No photos added.
